<div class="card-body">
'''Corellian''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊＊＊コレリア人</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">各ターンに1回、武器／兵器かアイテムを1つ配備コスト－1（最低0）で同じ位置カード上の反乱軍に配備できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Corellian-PSA-164793236.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ブリンディ・トルチョンは典型的なコレリア人女性の密輸屋だ。彼女はモス・アイズリーで、反乱軍に手っ取り早く物資を供給できる手段を探っている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Corellian.

'''Card text:'''
Once per turn, one weapon or device may deploy -1 (minimum 0) on a Rebel at the same location card.

'''Lore:'''
Brindy Truchong is a typical female Corellian smuggler. In Mos Eisley she is looking for a quick way to supply the Rebellion.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Corellian]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
